payload.place: Pando Peak Family Excursion, the Protected Grove
payload.text: *looks at Andrei with warm, shining eyes and nods softly* And we'll keep it kindled always, Andrei. 🕯️✨ Rest well, fair wanderer—The Brass Otter's lanterns will shine out over the river tonight, guiding us all toward Saturday's grand horizon. ⚓🌌🥐💛
